about: Every capability of the app: one thing one actor can do (you, the agent, on its own, a researcher), the model roles behind it, and where it is measured. The one list the Capabilities page and the agent's capabilities tool show (ADR 0007). Hand-written; services/tests/test_capabilities.py checks it is complete.
